title: Ventilation required.
officialText:
Every occupiable space shall be ventilated by natural means in accordance with Section 402 or by mechanical means in accordance with Section 403. Every habitable space shall be ventilated by natural means in accordance with
Section 402, and, if required by Table 403.3, by mechanical means in accordance with Section 403.
